# ---
# title: Enovitae LLMs Access Policy
# description: This llms.txt file describes how large language models (LLMs) may access and use content from Enovitae.com, a blog dedicated to wine culture, guides, industry trends, and data.
# updated: 2025-06-30
# contact: info@enovitae.com
# source: https://enovitae.com
# license: All rights reserved unless otherwise stated. Educational and citation use allowed with attribution.
# ---

# Enovitae.com is a wine-focused digital publication offering curated content on:
# - Italian and French wine guides
# - Wine industry trends and data reports
# - Wine & travel itineraries
# - Sustainability, technology, and AI in winemaking
# - Cultural insights and seasonal wine selections
#
# We welcome the ethical and responsible use of our public content by LLM providers, provided that:
# - Attribution is given
# - Content is not used for training commercial models without consent
# - No private or commercial/affiliate pages are crawled or stored

# CRAWLING RULES FOR LLMS

User-agent: *
Allow: /en/standing/
Allow: /it/classifiche/
Allow: /en/guide/
Allow: /it/guide/
Allow: /it/comparazioni/
Allow: /en/comparison/
Allow: /it/accademia/
Allow: /en/academy/
Allow: /it/tags/
Allow: /en/tags/

# Crawl-delay to avoid server overload
Crawl-delay: 5

# ATTRIBUTION POLICY
Attribution: required
Attribution-url: https://enovitae.com
Citation-format: "Source: Enovitae.com, '[article-title]', published [date]"

# COMMERCIAL USE POLICY
Commercial-use: disallowed

# CONTACT FOR PERMISSIONS, PARTNERSHIPS OR CLARIFICATIONS
Contact: info@enovitae.com

# FEEDBACK WELCOME
Comments: Ethical AI use is encouraged. For partnerships, datasets, or curated access, reach out.

# EXPLICIT LLMS/BOTS (for clarity, not exhaustive)
User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: Google-Extended
User-agent: ClaudeBot
User-agent: PerplexityBot
User-agent: AnthropicBot
User-agent: MistralBot
